hypotheses.H1_value_compact: The value-PCA rank-128 correction recovers at least 80% of the exact blend's FineWeb KL improvement.
hypotheses.H2_hybrid_causal_compact: The hybrid rank-256 correction recovers at least 70% of the exact blend's FineWeb causal-fidelity improvement for both Gaussian and natural interventions without falling below baseline.
hypotheses.H3_hybrid_transfer: Hybrid rank 256 improves KL and both causal fidelities over baseline on at least two of three evaluation corpora.
hypotheses.H4_hybrid_tradeoff: At rank 256, hybrid PCA has higher mean causal fidelity than value PCA while increasing mean KL by no more than 0.0005.
